protocol: Same author, procedural confirmation only; no independent human review. Each development dataset is marked after inspecting outcomes and continuing selection. Repeated question families/paraphrases are not new task domains.
development: quality-release.json (120): after prompt/model changed following pilot failures
quality-release2.json (128): after false calls on literal readback requests led to adapter policy
asr-regression-suite.json (2): failure from real frozen speech; both9B and7B miss ambiguous transcript
tts-final-load1/load3, tts-pool2-load1/load3 and tts-runtime-ab.json: configuration selection
prospective_confirmation: quality-release3.json (128) remains untouched for final score before locked candidate and comparator runs; freeze and source hashes in release3-lock.json.
known_label_errors_release2: no_tool-11: correct spoken date rejected by overly narrow numeric regex
no_tool-12: correct spoken number rejected by numeric regex
language-05: valid review advice failed incomplete keyword regex
handling: Retain raw scores and report label issues. Both4B and9B still have4/24 real false tool calls in release2, so correction would not change their rejection at that stage. Release3 allows spoken date/number and broader review keyword before outputs.
human_voice_rating: Not performed. Signal/timing/waveform metrics cannot establish naturalness or MOS.
confirmation_limit: release3 is procedurally frozen but related question families and same-author validators. 24 no-tool cases do not establish a population false-call rate ≤5%. Language proxy does not establish human-rated fluency.
